limitations: No actual OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude or Gemini API request was made; no API credentials were available or required. Provider requests/responses were mocked.
Ollama and browser CPU runtime contracts used controlled fixtures; no large language model was downloaded or benchmarked, and no real inference-quality claim is made.
No live GitHub push or external deployment occurred. All push/restore/retry checks used temporary local bare repositories and small synthetic weights, not multi-gigabyte production transfers.
Tests ran on Linux with Bash/Python/Node. They are not physical Mac Intel, Apple Silicon, Windows, phone or tablet device tests. Conda spaces and interpreter selection used executable fixtures.

Locale tests cover language negotiation, RTL logic, canonical text/cache/fallback/order/privacy contracts using controlled DOM fixtures. They do not establish human-reviewed accuracy for79 languages or real-browser typography.
The source curriculum was still being integrated during these software tests; course counts, final offline bundle, workbench and clean-rebuild validation belong to root’s separate final report.
